newIdentities.name: Acne Scarring
newIdentities.boundary: Distinct from the existing painful/unstable `scars` identity; this identity covers clinically documented acne scarring without presuming pain or instability.

newIdentities.name: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis
newIdentities.boundary: Site-specific lumbar phenotype derived from the broader spinal-stenosis concept; does not include cervical or thoracic stenosis.

newIdentities.name: Epilepsy
newIdentities.boundary: Distinct from the broader existing `seizure-disorder` identity. Requires an epilepsy diagnosis; acute symptomatic/provoked seizures alone do not qualify.

newIdentities.name: Guillain-Barré Syndrome
newIdentities.boundary: Acute immune-mediated polyradiculoneuropathy diagnosis; do not merge with generic peripheral neuropathy.

newIdentities.name: Reactive Arthritis
newIdentities.boundary: Postinfectious inflammatory arthritis diagnosis; do not merge with nonspecific arthralgia.

newIdentities.name: Lymphedema
newIdentities.boundary: Separate lymphatic swelling disorder; breast-cancer-related lymphedema is a treatment-associated subtype.

newIdentities.name: Endometrial Cancer
newIdentities.boundary: Malignancy of the endometrium; distinct from ovarian and cervical cancer identities.

newIdentities.name: Amebic Liver Abscess
newIdentities.boundary: Extraintestinal hepatic manifestation of Entamoeba histolytica infection; requires a separately documented liver abscess phenotype.

newIdentities.name: Pulmonary Embolism
newIdentities.boundary: Pulmonary arterial thromboembolism diagnosis; distinct from DVT and nonspecific pulmonary vascular disease.

approvedRelationships.title: Prevalence and risk factors of acne scars in patients with acne vulgaris
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented acne vulgaris/acne conglobata and separately documented acne scarring. Do not infer scarring from active acne alone. Do not substitute the existing painful/unstable-scars identity unless those scar characteristics are independently documented.

approvedRelationships.title: Comparative analysis of the results of decompressive interventions in elderly patients with cauda equine syndrome caused by lumbar spinal stenosis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented lumbar spinal stenosis and separately diagnosed cauda equina syndrome with correlating compressive/anatomic evidence. Do not generalize to cervical or thoracic stenosis. Radiculopathy, neurogenic claudication, bowel/bladder symptoms, or stenosis on imaging alone do not establish CES.

approvedRelationships.title: KDIGO 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Management of Anemia in Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented CKD and independently documented anemia. Do not infer anemia from CKD stage alone, and do not exclude evaluation for other clinically relevant causes of anemia.

approvedRelationships.title: Nephrolithiasis as a risk factor of chronic kidney disease: a meta-analysis of cohort studies with 4,770,691 participants
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented nephrolithiasis preceding separately documented CKD. This is population-level risk evidence and does not establish individual causation.

approvedRelationships.title: Arrhythmia-Induced Cardiomyopathy: JACC State-of-the-Art Review
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require a sustained or sufficiently burdensome culprit arrhythmia/tachyarrhythmia plus separately documented ventricular dysfunction consistent with arrhythmia-induced cardiomyopathy. Do not generalize to all transient or incidental arrhythmias. Reversibility after rhythm/rate control, when documented, strengthens attribution.

approvedRelationships.title: Urinary incontinence and erectile dysfunction in patients with localized or locally advanced prostate cancer: A nationwide observational study
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented prostate-cancer treatment, particularly radical prostatectomy, and separately documented post-treatment urinary incontinence. Do not infer incontinence from prostate cancer alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Urinary incontinence and erectile dysfunction in patients with localized or locally advanced prostate cancer: A nationwide observational study
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented prostate-cancer treatment (for example radical prostatectomy or radiotherapy) and separately documented post-treatment erectile dysfunction. Do not infer ED from prostate cancer alone.

approvedRelationships.title: The burden of skin cancer in heart transplant recipients: Impact of immunosuppressive regimens
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented heart transplantation, chronic post-transplant immunosuppression, and separately diagnosed skin malignancy after transplant. Do not infer skin cancer from transplant status alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Characteristics and outcome of facial nerve palsy from Lyme neuroborreliosis in the United States
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented Lyme neuroborreliosis or otherwise clinically attributable neurologic Lyme disease and separately documented cranial nerve palsy, most commonly facial nerve palsy. Do not generalize to uncomplicated Lyme disease.

approvedRelationships.title: Quantifying the association between Campylobacter infection and Guillain-Barré syndrome: a systematic review
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented Campylobacter infection preceding a separately diagnosed Guillain-Barré syndrome. Do not infer GBS from enteritis alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Enteric Infection-Associated Reactive Arthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented Campylobacter infection preceding separately diagnosed reactive arthritis. Preserve the postinfectious temporal relationship and do not infer arthritis from infection alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Enteric Infection-Associated Reactive Arthritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented Salmonella or Shigella infection preceding separately diagnosed reactive arthritis. Preserve the postinfectious temporal relationship and do not infer arthritis from infection alone.

approvedRelationships.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of the aetiology of acute pancreatitis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply only to documented gallstone/cholelithiasis or biliary gallbladder disease with separately diagnosed acute pancreatitis attributable to a biliary etiology. Do not generalize to every gallbladder disorder.

approvedRelationships.title: Knee osteoarthritis risk is increased 4-6 fold after knee injury - a systematic review and meta-analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require a documented structural traumatic knee injury (for example ACL and/or meniscal injury) preceding separately documented post-traumatic knee osteoarthritis. Do not infer OA from nonspecific knee pain or strain alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Dietary Management of Chronic Kidney Disease and Secondary Hyperoxaluria in Patients with Short Bowel Syndrome and Type 3 Intestinal Failure
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented short-bowel/short-gut syndrome with the relevant malabsorptive phenotype, especially colon-in-continuity/enteric hyperoxaluria when applicable, and separately documented stone disease. Do not generalize to all short-bowel phenotypes.

approvedRelationships.title: Chronic non-freezing cold injury results in neuropathic pain due to a sensory neuropathy
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply to documented non-freezing cold injury with persistent objectively supported sensory neuropathy. Do not generalize this source to all freezing injuries or every cold-injury residual phenotype.

approvedRelationships.title: Risk factors of unilateral breast cancer-related lymphedema: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 84 cohort studies
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented breast-cancer treatment with relevant lymphatic disruption/exposure (for example axillary node surgery and/or regional radiotherapy) and separately documented lymphedema. Do not infer lymphedema from breast cancer alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Chemotherapy-Associated Peripheral Neuropathy in Patients With Early-Stage Breast Cancer: A Systematic Review
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented neurotoxic breast-cancer chemotherapy exposure (such as taxane/platinum-containing therapy when applicable) and separately documented chemotherapy-associated peripheral neuropathy.

approvedRelationships.title: Trastuzumab-induced cardiomyopathy
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented cardiotoxic breast-cancer treatment exposure, particularly trastuzumab and/or relevant anthracycline exposure, plus separately diagnosed treatment-associated cardiomyopathy or ventricular dysfunction. Do not infer cardiomyopathy from breast cancer alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Systematic review of long-term chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN) following adjuvant oxaliplatin for colorectal cancer
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented oxaliplatin-containing colorectal-cancer chemotherapy and separately documented chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy. Do not generalize to colorectal cancer without neurotoxic treatment.

approvedRelationships.title: Healthcare resource use and costs associated with chronic kidney disease in US private insurance patients with multiple myeloma
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented multiple myeloma and separately documented CKD after or attributable to myeloma-related renal disease. CKD chronicity criteria must be satisfied; do not relabel transient AKI or nonspecific renal impairment as CKD.

approvedRelationships.title: Natural history of scoliosis in cerebral palsy and risk factors for progression of scoliosis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented cerebral palsy and separately documented scoliosis. Preserve the higher-risk severe/spastic phenotypes described in the source and do not infer scoliosis from CP alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Risk of endometrial cancer in patients with polycystic ovarian syndrome: A meta-analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented PCOS preceding separately diagnosed endometrial cancer. Treat as population-level association/risk evidence; do not claim individual causation and preserve confounding limitations including BMI.

approvedRelationships.title: The modern management of uterine fibroids-related abnormal uterine bleeding
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented uterine fibroids with clinically relevant abnormal/heavy uterine bleeding and separately documented iron deficiency and/or anemia. Do not infer anemia from asymptomatic fibroids.

approvedRelationships.title: Partial Nephrectomy Versus Radical Nephrectomy for Clinical T1b and T2 Renal Tumors: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Comparative Studies
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented nephrectomy for renal malignancy and separately documented new or worsened postoperative CKD satisfying chronicity criteria. Do not infer CKD from kidney cancer alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Amebic liver abscess: An update
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented Entamoeba histolytica infection/amebiasis and separately documented amebic liver abscess using appropriate clinical/imaging/laboratory evidence. Do not infer hepatic abscess from intestinal colonization alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Management of Complications and Vision Loss from Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply only to proliferative diabetic retinopathy with separately documented tractional retinal detachment. Do not generalize this source to nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy or unrelated rhegmatogenous detachment.

approvedRelationships.title: Arrhythmias in myocarditis: State of the art
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply only to the documented myocarditis phenotype within the broader cardiac-inflammatory identity and separately documented arrhythmia. Do not generalize to every inflammatory cardiac diagnosis.

approvedRelationships.title: Morbidity and mortality associated with atherosclerotic peripheral artery disease: A systematic review
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply only to documented atherosclerotic lower-extremity peripheral artery disease, especially critical limb-threatening ischemia, with separately documented major amputation/loss of use. Do not generalize to venous disease or nonspecific vascular diagnoses.

approvedRelationships.title: Surgical managements for rhegmatogenous retinal detachment: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trial
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented retinal-detachment surgery involving pars plana vitrectomy (with or without scleral buckle as applicable) and separately documented postoperative cataract progression. Do not infer cataract from untreated retinal detachment.

approvedRelationships.title: Outcomes and predictors of complications after distal deep vein thrombosis: a prospective analysis of 8488 patients
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented DVT preceding separately documented pulmonary embolism. Do not infer PE from DVT alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Pulmonary vascular resistance predicts the mortality in patients with bronchiectasis-associated pulmonary hypertension
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented bronchiectasis and separately documented pulmonary hypertension using appropriate hemodynamic/clinical evidence. Do not infer pulmonary hypertension from bronchiectasis severity alone.

approvedRelationships.title: Early and late ventricular arrhythmias complicating ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply to documented acute myocardial infarction, particularly STEMI consistent with the source, with separately documented ventricular arrhythmia occurring in the relevant post-infarction period. Do not generalize to every remote MI history.

approvedRelationships.title: Natural history of periodontitis: Disease progression and tooth loss over 40 years
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented periodontitis/periodontal disease and separately documented tooth loss attributable to periodontal attachment/bone loss. Do not infer cause of tooth loss when caries, trauma, extraction for other reasons, or other etiologies predominate.

approvedRelationships.title: Risk and prognosis of ovarian cancer in women with endometriosis: a meta-analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented endometriosis preceding separately diagnosed ovarian cancer. Treat as population-level association/risk evidence, with strongest histologic signal for endometrioid/clear-cell disease; do not claim individual causation.

approvedRelationships.title: Cerebral malaria as a risk factor for the development of epilepsy and other long-term neurological conditions: a meta-analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Apply only to documented cerebral malaria, predominantly pediatric populations consistent with the evidence, followed by separately diagnosed epilepsy. Do not generalize to uncomplicated malaria or isolated acute febrile/provoked seizures.

approvedRelationships.title: Association between epilepsy and risk of depression: A meta-analysis
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require separately diagnosed epilepsy and depressive disorder. Treat as association/risk evidence with acknowledged bidirectionality and shared-confounding potential; do not claim epilepsy necessarily causes depression.

approvedRelationships.title: Post-traumatic epilepsy in adults: a nationwide register-based study
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented focal cerebral injury/contusion or diffuse cerebral injury consistent with the source and separately diagnosed post-traumatic epilepsy. Do not equate early provoked post-traumatic seizures with epilepsy.

approvedRelationships.title: Long-term risk of epilepsy after traumatic brain injury in children and young adults: a population-based cohort study
approvedRelationships.publicationGuard: Require documented traumatic skull fracture and separately diagnosed subsequent epilepsy. Do not equate acute provoked seizures with epilepsy, and preserve the source population/age limitations when applying the evidence.
